item.title: DLP and UEBA Are Asking the Wrong Insider Risk Questions
item.description: According to IBM's Cost of a Data Breach report, a breach that begins with a malicious insider costs $4.99M on average (the costliest initial vector measured). Mean time to identify and contain it: 260 days. Ask a security leader whether insider risk matters and the answer comes back immediately. item.title: How Cloudflare WAF helps protect against Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938)
item.description: Java4Shell is a critical memory-corruption flaw in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder that can lead to remote code execution. Cloudflare has released six WAF managed rules for paid plans that logs matching requests by default. Patch your Java runtimes now.

item.title: The State of Ransomware Q3 2026
item.description: Ransomware reached record levels in Q3 2026, but the scale of activity is only part of what changed. The ecosystem producing those attacks is becoming increasingly fragmented: more ransomware brands are claiming victims, the top groups account for a smaller share of overall activity, and several major organizations are pushing back against high-value ransom demands.
